note: Keyword matching is applied to the expanded WBS task name. A requirement with no matching task is reported as a missing anchor, never invented.

acceptance.description: Third-party fire testing -> fire acceptance / filing -> rectification re-check -> formal document.
acceptance.envelope_note: This chain is serial, so the finish envelope over every independent TRUE/FALSE combination is exactly bounded by [none required, all required]. Scenario enumeration uses those two bounds.

independence_rule.statement: construction permit / fire design review / fire acceptance / fire filing / third-party testing / landlord approval / joint completion are INDEPENDENT decisions.
forbidden: construction permit exempt MUST NOT imply fire requirements exempt
